#28Statesin28Weeks

#allindiatravel 
#indiatravel

The greatest souvenir from any journey is rarely a photograph. It's the faith you regain in people.
Travel has a strange way of proving that the world isn't as lonely as it sometimes feels. Every train, every hostel, every mountain trail introduces you to people who owe you nothing, yet leave you with kindness you'll remember for years.
And if you've already chosen this life of backpacks, train stations and uncertain plans, you know exactly what I mean. We don't travel because we're running away from home.
We travel because every journey quietly expands the meaning of the word home.
